title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
description: Validates overall foundational understanding of AWS Cloud concepts, core security, compliance, services, and billing.

questions.statement: Which AWS Cloud computing concept describes a system's ability to automatically adjust computing resources based on instant increases or decreases in demand?

options.explanation: Correct: Elasticity is the ability to acquire resources as you need them and release resources when you no longer need them.
Incorrect: Fault tolerance is the ability of a system to remain operational despite component failures.
Incorrect: Agility refers to the speed and ease with which organizations can innovate and deploy resources.
Incorrect: Durability refers to long-term data protection against loss or corruption.

questions.generalExplanation: Elasticity allows infrastructure to automatically expand and contract, ensuring availability without unnecessary over-provisioning costs.

questions.statement: According to the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which TWO tasks are the responsibility of the CUSTOMER when using Amazon EC2 instances? (Choose TWO.)

options.text: Installing patches and updates on the guest operating system (guest OS).
options.explanation: Correct: In the EC2 IaaS model, the customer is responsible for maintaining, patching, and securing the operating system on the instance.

options.text: Configuring inbound and outbound firewall rules (Security Groups).
options.explanation: Correct: Managing virtual firewall rules (Security Groups and Network ACLs) is the direct responsibility of the customer.

options.text: Physical maintenance and secure disposal of storage drives in data centers.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Physical security and hardware decommissioning are the sole responsibility of AWS ('Security OF the Cloud').

options.text: Applying patches to the hypervisor that virtualizes physical servers.
options.explanation: Incorrect: The virtualization layer and hypervisor are managed by AWS.

options.text: Providing redundant power generators and cooling in physical facilities.
options.explanation: Incorrect: Physical facilities and data center utilities are the responsibility of AWS.

questions.generalExplanation: Under the Shared Responsibility Model, AWS manages 'Security OF the Cloud' (hardware, data centers, facilities, hypervisor), while customers manage 'Security IN the Cloud' (guest OS, application code, firewalls, and IAM access controls).

questions.statement: Which AWS service allows you to run code without provisioning or managing physical or virtual servers, charging only for the compute time consumed in milliseconds?

options.explanation: Correct: AWS Lambda is the core serverless event-driven compute service from AWS.
Incorrect: Amazon EC2 requires provisioning and managing virtual machine instances.
Incorrect: Amazon Lightsail provides simplified pre-configured virtual private servers.
Incorrect: Elastic Beanstalk is an orchestration deployment platform that provisions underlying EC2 instances.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Lambda is the foundational serverless compute service on AWS, enabling event-driven code execution with automatic scaling and sub-second millisecond billing.

questions.statement: A company wants to receive automated email or SMS notifications whenever account forecasted or actual costs exceed a predetermined monthly budget threshold. Which service meets this requirement?

options.explanation: Correct: AWS Budgets allows you to set custom budgets and trigger alert notifications when actual or forecasted costs exceed targets.
Incorrect: The Pricing Calculator is a pre-deployment cost estimation tool.
Incorrect: Delivers raw granular usage data to Amazon S3 for BI analysis, but does not provide real-time alert triggers.
Incorrect: Provides best practice recommendations and cost optimization checks, but is not the primary budget tracking and threshold alert tool.

questions.generalExplanation: AWS Budgets is the dedicated tool to track costs, usage, and reservations, enabling customized alerts based on actual or forecasted spending metrics.
